summary: Eight years at Northwind Finance, a fictional lender used as the example for this template. I started in customer support, spent four years in branch operations, and now work in the retail lending analytics team at head office.

Today I build monthly portfolio reports, track application funnels and share findings with regional managers. Before that I helped launch a two-wheeler loan product in three cities. I want to move into a product analyst role in financial services.
skills: funnel analysis, cohort tracking, portfolio reports, KPI definitions
monthly management packs, regional dashboards, written summaries for leadership
regional managers, branch teams, dealers, credit and collections teams
report automation, data cleaning rules, handover documents
pilot planning, branch training, weekly pipeline reviews
retail lending, two-wheeler loans, collections, customer service
tools: Excel, SQL, Power BI, Python (pandas), Google Sheets, Jira

experience.title: Senior Analyst, Retail Lending Analytics
experience.intro: The team reports on loan applications, approvals and early repayments for the retail lending business.
bullets: Built a monthly portfolio pack covering 14 regions, replacing three separate spreadsheets that regional managers used to merge by hand.
Cut report preparation time from 3 days to 1 day by moving data cleaning steps into SQL and a short Python script.
Tracked the application funnel each week and flagged regions where approval rates dropped by more than 5 points.

experience.title: Operations Officer, Branch Banking
bullets: Helped launch two-wheeler loans in three cities: trained branch staff, set up dealer onboarding and reviewed the pipeline every Monday.
Moved 45% of cash-paying customers to digital repayment through in-branch help desks.
Kept loan files audit-ready; the branch had zero major audit findings in two yearly audits.

experience.title: Customer Support Executive
bullets: Answered loan and repayment questions by phone and in branch, and logged recurring complaints for the operations team.

portfolio.name: Loan funnel dashboard (practice project)
bullets: Built a Power BI dashboard on a public lending dataset of 50,000 synthetic applications, showing drop-off at each stage.
Wrote a one-page note on where applicants drop off and two changes worth testing.

portfolio.name: Collections call notes cleaner
bullets: Wrote a Python script that groups free-text call notes into 6 reasons for missed payments, tested on 1,200 made-up notes.
